title: Subbing at the Cotton Club and being hired by Cab Calloway
summary: He subs for Doc Cheatham at the Cotton Club and Cab then hires him on salary, the best-paying band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Then Doc Cheetam is the first trumpet player (inaudible). So he got sick. They had a big production, and they needed somebody to come in there and (inaudible).
He was there when the Cotton Club was on 48th Street. So a friend of mine Shaw Perez (phonetic), flute player, had a little number band in there in the Cotton Club.

(Inaudible). He say, well, you need somebody to cut that show. Can't go wrong with Mario. So I got there. They sent for me. I got there 6:30 in the afternoon, play half an hour that is music, soft music for dinner. So they give me the choice of the show. The conductor said, let's go. The show caught my (inaudible). Everybody -- woo, woo-ed. All right. So I work in there about three days. (Inaudible) well, came back. But the week after that they called me -- I would like for you to come to work steady.
Well, that was the best job in town. That band pay more money than any band, even Duke. So I took the job.
